sections.title: 一、完形填空
sections.instruction: 完形填空 (每小题2分, 共20分)
sections.passage:
Hello, my name is Martha and I'm 13 years old. I [1] in a middle school near my home. I like my school because there is a big [2] and I can find many interesting books there.

In our class there are twenty-seven students. Our classroom is large and [3]. Everything is in the right place. We put our [4] in the bookcases at the back. We [5] some pictures of famous people on the walls. There is a [6] in the front. It has a big screen. With its help, we can study well. My desk is [7] and my chair is yellow too. My schoolbag is on my chair.

Ms Reed is our class teacher and she teaches [8]. She often helps us study English after class. She is really [9] to us and we all love her.

My good friend is Ella. We often help each other, and she [10] next to me. We are deskmates. I'm very happy studying in this school.

questions.translation: 我在这所离家很近的中学学习。
questions.explanation: 根据后文“studying in this school”可知，此处表示“学习”，故选study。

questions.translation: 我喜欢我的学校，因为这里有一个很大的图书馆，我能在那里找到许多有趣的书。
questions.explanation: 根据后文“and I can find many interesting books there”可知，能找到书的地方是图书馆（library）。

questions.translation: 我们的教室又大又整洁。
questions.explanation: 根据下文“Everything is in the right place.”（井井有条）可知，教室很整洁（tidy）。

questions.translation: 我们把书放在后面的书柜里。
questions.explanation: 根据“bookcases”（书柜）可知，放在里面的应该是书（books）。

questions.translation: 我们在墙上张贴了一些名人的照片。
questions.explanation: put up意为“张贴”，符合把照片贴在墙上的语境。

questions.translation: 前面有一台电脑。它有一个大屏幕。
questions.explanation: 根据“It has a big screen.”可知，此处指带有大屏幕的电脑（computer）。

questions.translation: 我的桌子是黄色的，我的椅子也是黄色的。
questions.explanation: 根据句中的“and my chair is yellow too”可知，桌子也是黄色的（yellow）。

questions.translation: 里德女士是我们的班主任，她教英语。
questions.explanation: 根据下文“She often helps us study English after class.”可知，她教英语（English）。

questions.translation: 她对我们真的很好，我们都爱她。
questions.explanation: 根据“we all love her”可知，老师对大家很好（kind）。

questions.translation: 我们经常互相帮助，她坐在我旁边。我们是同桌。
questions.explanation: 根据“We are deskmates.”可知，同桌是坐在（sits）旁边。

sections.title: 二、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 阅读理解 (每小题5分, 共35分)
sections.passage:
Every school is special! Let's see what Lily's, Mike's, and Fred's schools have.

| Student | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Lily** | My school is big and fun. It has a large playground. Children can run and play there. There is a new library with many interesting books. Students eat lunch in a small dining hall. My school also has two pink classroom buildings with big windows. |
| **Mike** | My school has a beautiful garden with many flowers and vegetables. There is also a sports field. Children play sports here. My school has ten red classrooms and many green trees. |
| **Fred** | My school is close to nature (自然). It has a small farm with animals. You can see colourful flowers everywhere. Students can do different kinds of sports in the playground. |

questions.prompt: 11. Whose school has a new library?
questions.translation: 谁的学校有一个新图书馆？
questions.explanation: 根据表格中Lily的描述“There is a new library with many interesting books.”可知，是Lily的学校。

questions.prompt: 12. What do Mike's and Fred's schools have in common (有......共同之处)?
options: They both have a small farm.
questions.translation: 迈克和弗雷德的学校有什么共同之处？
questions.explanation: 根据Mike的描述“with many flowers and vegetables”以及Fred的描述“You can see colourful flowers everywhere.”可知，两人的学校都有很多花。

questions.prompt: 13. What are they talking about?
questions.translation: 他们在谈论什么？
questions.explanation: 文章开头“Let's see what Lily's, Mike's, and Fred's schools have.”及表格内容表明，大家都在谈论各自的学校。

sections.title: 三、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 阅读理解 (每小题5分, 共35分)
sections.passage:
We know the school library is a good place. But do you know why? The school library has many books for you to read. You can read all kinds of books in it. Many of them are about Chinese, English, maths, music, sports and so on. You can learn a lot from them.

The school library is a good place for studying. It is quiet because no students talk in it. You can do your homework or look for information you need in your studies. When you have a problem (问题), you may find the answer from one of the books in the school library.

There is a computer room in the school library. You can do some reading or look for information on the computer. Sometimes when you are bored (无聊的), you can listen to music on it.

So if you have time, please go to the school library often.

questions.prompt: 14. What kind of books is not mentioned in Paragraph 2?
questions.translation: 第二段（注：对应文章第一段列举的书籍种类）中没有提到哪种书？
questions.explanation: 第一段中提到了Chinese, English, maths, music, sports等，未提及关于computers的书籍。

questions.prompt:
15. Why is the school library a good place for students?
① Because they can read many kinds of books.
② Because they can find information on the computer.
③ Because sometimes they can listen to music to relax (放松).
④ Because they can talk about their problems with friends.
questions.translation: 为什么学校图书馆对学生来说是个好地方？
questions.explanation: 根据文章内容，图书馆有各种书（①正确），可以在电脑上找资料（②正确），可以听音乐放松（③正确）；而图书馆要求保持安静，不能和朋友大声讨论问题（④错误）。故选①②③。

questions.prompt:
16. Which of the following best shows the structure (结构) of the text? (①=Paragraph 1...) [HTML:

Article Structure Analysis:

  • Paragraph 1: Introduction (Library has many books)
  • Paragraph 2: Feature 1 (A good place for quiet studying)
  • Paragraph 3: Feature 2 (Computer room facilities)
  • Paragraph 4: Conclusion (Recommendation to visit often)
]
questions.translation: 下列哪一项最能展示文章的结构？（①=第一段……）
questions.explanation: 文章共四段：第一段总起介绍图书馆有许多书；第二、三段分别从学习和电脑室功能两个方面阐述原因；第四段总结呼吁。因此结构为 ① / ②③ / ④。

questions.prompt: 17. What is the purpose (目的) of the text?
options: To let us know the good books in the school library.
To tell us why the school library is a good place for students.
To tell us the school library is a good place for making friends.
To ask students to use computers in the school library often.
questions.translation: 这篇文章的目的是什么？
questions.explanation: 文章开篇提出问题“But do you know why?”随后从读书、学习、电脑室等方面阐述了图书馆是好地方的原因，故目的是告诉我们为什么学校图书馆是个好地方。

sections.title: 四、阅读表达
sections.instruction: 阅读表达 (每小题3分, 共15分)
sections.passage:
Hello, everybody! I am Kevin. I am a student of Moonlight Middle School. My school is very beautiful. I study in Class Two, Grade Seven.

Look! There is a map of our school on the wall. There are four buildings and five gardens in our school. In the gardens, there are a lot of beautiful flowers, grass and trees. There is a big playground in my school. It is in the middle of the school. On the left of the playground, there is a building. The library is on the second floor and the third floor. On the first floor, there are two big reading rooms. I like reading there very much. I often borrow books from the library too. There is a teaching building behind the library. We study in that building. My classroom is on the second floor in it. The science rooms, the computer rooms and the music rooms are all on the fifth floor. The teachers' offices are in that building too.

Where is the sports hall? Oh, it's on the right of the playground. We often have PE lessons in the sports hall. The canteen is also a building behind the sports hall. We have lunch and dinner in the canteen.

I like my school, because my school is very beautiful. In the school, I feel very happy!

questions.prompt: 18. How many buildings are there in Kevin's school?
questions.translation: 凯文的学校里有多少栋建筑？
questions.explanation: 根据文中“There are four buildings and five gardens in our school.”可知，学校有四栋建筑，故选B。

questions.prompt: 19. Is the playground on the right of the library?
questions.translation: 操场在图书馆的右边吗？
questions.explanation: 根据文中“On the left of the playground, there is a building. The library is on the second floor...”可知，图书馆在操场的左边，因此操场在图书馆的右边。故选A。

questions.prompt: 20. Where does Kevin often read books?
questions.translation: 凯文经常在哪里看书？
questions.explanation: 根据文中“On the first floor, there are two big reading rooms. I like reading there very much.”可知，他在阅览室看书，故选C。

questions.prompt: 21. What do students often do in the sports hall?
questions.translation: 学生们经常在体育馆里做什么？
questions.explanation: 根据文中“We often have PE lessons in the sports hall.”可知，学生们经常在体育馆上体育课，故选B。

questions.prompt: 22. Do you like the sports hall in your school? Why or why not?
options: Yes, because I can play basketball and exercise there.
No, because the library has many interesting books.
Yes, because there are four buildings in the school.
No, because we have lunch in the school canteen.
questions.translation: 你喜欢你们学校的体育馆吗？为什么？
questions.explanation: 根据体育馆的功能，选项A“喜欢，因为可以在那里打篮球和锻炼身体”符合语境和逻辑。

sections.title: 五、语法填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文, 在空白处填入一个适当的单词或括号内所给词的正确形式, 使短文通顺、完整。
sections.passage:
I like my new school. There is a big swimming pool in my school. It's fun [23] (have) swimming classes there! There is also [24] beautiful small garden and we can [25] (take) a walk there. My new teachers are nice to me [26] my new classmates are friendly too. My head teacher Mr Zhang is really fun. He [27] (teach) us maths. His classes are always very interesting and he always helps us [28] our schoolwork. I feel lucky to be [29] (he) student.

There are 42 students in my class. I make friends with my classmates. The school also has many clubs and I'm going to join the volleyball club. I think [30] (do) sports with my classmates is enjoyable because I'm good at [31] (play) volleyball. Guess what I like most about my new school? The food! There [32] (be) so many delicious dishes on the menu. I like tofu more than other food. I look forward to having lunch at the school canteen every day!

To me school life is not only a journey of learning but also a journey of discovery. It never ends, and it's always exciting.

questions.prompt: 23. It's fun ______ (have) swimming classes there!
questions.translation: 在那里上游泳课很有趣！
questions.explanation: 句型It is + adj. + to do sth.中，it是形式主语，真正的的主语是后面的动词不定式，故填to have。

questions.prompt: 24. There is also ______ beautiful small garden...
questions.translation: 还有一个美丽的小花园……
questions.explanation: garden是可数名词单数，此处表泛指，且beautiful发音以辅音音素开头，故用不定冠词a。

questions.prompt: 25. ...and we can ______ (take) a walk there.
questions.translation: ……我们可以在那里散步。
questions.explanation: 情态动词can后接动词原形，故填take。

questions.prompt: 26. My new teachers are nice to me ______ my new classmates are friendly too.
questions.translation: 我的新老师对我都很好，我的新同学们也很友好。
questions.explanation: 前后分句是并列关系，表示顺承，故用and连接。

questions.prompt: 27. He ______ (teach) us maths.
questions.translation: 他教我们数学。
questions.explanation: 主语He是第三人称单数，描述客观事实用一般现在时，谓语动词用第三人称单数形式teaches。

questions.prompt: 28. ...and he always helps us ______ our schoolwork.
questions.translation: ……并且他总是帮助我们做功课。
questions.explanation: help sb. with sth.是固定搭配，意为“在某方面帮助某人”，故填with。

questions.prompt: 29. I feel lucky to be ______ (he) student.
questions.translation: 能成为他的学生我感到很幸运。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词student需要用形容词性物主代词his（他的）。

questions.prompt: 30. I think ______ (do) sports with my classmates is enjoyable...
questions.translation: 我认为和同学们一起做运动是令人愉快的……
questions.explanation: 动名词短语作宾语从句中的主语，故填doing。

questions.prompt: 31. ...because I'm good at ______ (play) volleyball.
questions.translation: ……因为我擅长打排球。
questions.explanation: be good at doing sth.是固定搭配，at是介词，后接动名词playing。

questions.prompt: 32. There ______ (be) so many delicious dishes on the menu.
questions.translation: 菜单上有那么多美味的菜肴。
questions.explanation: There be句型遵循就近原则，主语“so many delicious dishes”是复数，且时态为一般现在时，故be动词用are。
